remarks: Welcome to modern city living in Stamford's vibrant Mid City neighborhood! This stunning 2-bed, 3.5-bath townhouse blends style, comfort, and convenience just moments from downtown shops, parks, and restaurants. The bright open-concept kitchen and living area offer the perfect flow for entertaining or relaxing, with tall windows bringing in natural light throughout. Each bedroom features a private en-suite bath, and the finished lower level provides flexible space for a home office, gym, or guest suite. Hardwood floors, central A/C, and in-unit laundry add everyday comfort. Private garage parking included. Enjoy an unbeatable location-walk to restaurants, coffee shops, and entertainment, or take a short drive to Metro-North, I-95, and major employers. Parks, fitness studios, and waterfront trails are just minutes away, making it easy to balance work and lifestyle. This townhouse combines the best of low-maintenance living with the feel of a private home. Whether you're commuting, working remotely, or exploring downtown Stamford, 102 Forest Street offers the space, quality, and location to truly live well.
